description.value:
Frequency once per day

You activate a magitech crystal integrated in your body, causing it to shoot a 120-foot-long line of otherworldly energy that tears the fabric of space and time. You deal @Damage[10d6[force]] damage to creatures in the line. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage, and you teleport the creature up to 15 feet into an unoccupied space of your choice along the line's area.

Failure The creature takes full damage, and you teleport the creature up to 30 feet into an unoccupied space of your choice along the line's area.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1}, and you teleport the creature to any unoccupied space of your choice along the line's area.
